selected_evidence.requirement: Pick up each new certificate while continuing to answer requests

commands.command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-certificate >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_CERT_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cert_dir=/etc/nginx/tls
cert_file=$cert_dir/server.crt
key_file=$cert_dir/server.key
renew_before_seconds=604800

sudo_cmd=
[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || sudo_cmd=sudo
$sudo_cmd install -d -m 0755 "$cert_dir"
if [ -s "$cert_file" ] && [ -s "$key_file" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$renew_before_seconds" -noout -in "$cert_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi

tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "$cert_dir/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
node_ip=$(hostname -I | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -v '^127\.' | head -n 1)
[ -n "$node_ip" ]
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -subj "/CN=$(hostname)" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$(hostname),IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$tmp_dir/server.key" -out "$tmp_dir/server.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$tmp_dir/server.key"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_dir/server.crt"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/server.key" "$key_file"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/server.crt" "$cert_file"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
rmdir "$tmp_dir"
if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
ANTRIEB_CERT_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-certificate
sudo /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-certificate
sudo openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -ext subjectAltName

[Install]
